errors.llm_failed: AI સહાયક વ્યસ્ત છે. એક મિનિટમાં ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો, અથવા નિષ્ણાતને પૂછો.
errors.search_failed: કારાગિર હમણાં શોધી શક્યો નથી. ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો અથવા નિષ્ણાતને પૂછો.
errors.busy: ઘણા લોકો હમણાં પૂછતા હોય છે. એક મિનિટમાં ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો.
errors.server_restarted: જવાબ આપતી વખતે સર્વર ફરી શરૂ થયું. ફરી પૂછો.
errors.internal: કંઈક ખોટું થયું. ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો અથવા નિષ્ણાતને પૂછો.
errors.rate_limited: તમે ખૂબ ઝડપથી પૂછો છો. એક મિનિટ રાહ જુઓ અને ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો.
errors.audio_too_big: રેકોર્ડિંગ ખૂબ લાંબુ છે. એક મિનિટથી ઓછું રાખો.
errors.unsupported_audio: આ ફોનનું રેકોર્ડિંગ ફોર્મેટ સપોર્ટેડ નથી. તેના બદલે પ્રશ્ન ટાઇપ કરો.
errors.stream_cut: જવાબ પૂરો થવા પહેલાં કનેક્શન તૂટી ગયું. 'મારા પ્રશ્નો' ખોલો અથવા ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો.
errors.network: કનેક્શન નથી. ઇન્ટરનેટ તપાસો અને ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો.
errors.not_open: આ પ્રશ્ન પહેલેથી જ જવાબ આપ્યો છે અથવા બંધ છે.
errors.assigned_to_other: બીજો નિષ્ણાત આ પ્રશ્નનો જવાબ આપી રહ્યો છે.
errors.reply_in_progress: તમારો જવાબ પહેલેથી જ ચકાસણી માટે રાહ જોઈ રહ્યો છે.
errors.own_question: તમે તમારા પોતાના પ્રશ્નનો જવાબ આપી શકતા નથી.

voice.autoSpeak: જ્યારે હું વોઇસથી પૂછું ત્યારે જવાબો જોરથી બોલો

vad.autoSend: જ્યારે હું બોલવાનું બંધ કરું ત્યારે મોકલો
vad.waiting: હવે બોલો. બંધ કરો ત્યારે મોકલે છે.
vad.hearing: સાંભળું છું… મોકલવા માટે બોલવાનું બંધ કરો
vad.heardNothing: કંઈ સાંભળ્યું નથી. ગેજ પર ટેપ કરો અને ફરી પ્રયત્ન કરો, ફોનની નજીક.

errors.load: Couldn't load this page. Check the connection and reload.

errors.employee_id_taken: This employee ID is already used in this plant.
errors.employee_id_required: Technicians and experts sign in with an employee ID.
errors.email_required: Supervisors sign in on the web with their work email.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Who can use Kaarigar in this plant.
people.summary: {{active}} people can sign in · {{new}} haven't signed in yet

empty.current: No people yet. Add your technicians and experts so they can sign in on their phones.
empty.new: Everyone has signed in at least once.

roleHint.expert: Also records repairs and answers questions

form.supervisorFixed: Supervisors sign in with email, so their role can't change to technician or expert.
form.name: Full name
form.employeeIdHint: The ID printed on their card. They type it with a PIN to sign in.
form.emailHint: They sign in at the web dashboard with this email.
form.languageHint: Kaarigar listens and answers in this language. They can change it in the app.
form.adminHint: Can add people and machines, upload documents and breakdown logs.

reset.title: New PIN for {{name}}?
reset.body: Their old PIN stops working right away. You'll see the new PIN once, to give to them.
reset.bodyEmail: Their old password stops working right away. You'll see a temporary password once, to give to them.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: They can't sign in any more. Their repair notes stay in the knowledge base with their name. Questions waiting for them go back to unassigned.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: They can sign in again with their old PIN or password. If they forgot it, make a new one after this.

slip.title: Login for {{name}}
slip.once: This is the only time you'll see this. Kaarigar doesn't keep it. Give it to them now or print the slip.
slip.howPin: Open Kaarigar on your phone, enter your employee ID and this PIN.
slip.howEmail: Sign in at the Kaarigar dashboard and change this password from the login page.

machines.title: Machines
machines.summary: {{count}} machines on the floor · {{missing}} without a printed sticker
machines.emptyHint: Add each machine with its code. Then print its QR sticker so technicians can scan it.

form.name: Name
form.modelHint: Manuals are uploaded per model, so all machines of a model share them.

archive.title: Archive {{code}}?
archive.body: It disappears from technicians' machine lists and its sticker stops opening it. Its repairs and history stay in the knowledge base. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore {{code}}?
restore.body: It comes back on technicians' machine lists and its sticker works again.

newqr.title: Make a new QR for {{code}}?
newqr.body: The old sticker stops working right away. Use this when a sticker is lost or damaged, then print and stick the new one.

stickers.subtitle: A4, 8 stickers per page. Print on sticker paper or plain paper and laminate.
stickers.none: No machines selected. Go back and tick the machines you want stickers for.
stickers.tip: Print at 100% scale (not "fit to page"). When they're on the machines, mark them as printed.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: Everything Kaarigar answers from: expert repairs, manuals and breakdown history.
knowledge.emptyHint: Approve expert repairs in the review queue, or upload a manual in
knowledge.noMatch: Nothing matches. Try other words or another machine.
knowledge.searchNotUpdated: Restored, but Kaarigar couldn't update search right now. It will be used in answers after the next reindex.

archive.title: Archive this repair?
archive.body_one: Kaarigar stops using it in answers right away. It was used in {{count}} answer. You can restore it later.
archive.body_other: Kaarigar stops using it in answers right away. It was used in {{count}} answers. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore this repair?
restore.body_one: Kaarigar starts using it in answers again.
restore.body_other: Kaarigar starts using it in answers again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Manuals, SOPs and safety sheets Kaarigar reads to answer questions.

form.tooBig: This file is bigger than {{mb}} MB. Split it or compress it first.
form.title: Title
form.noModels: Add a model in Machines first.

job.doneText: Done. Kaarigar can now answer from this document.

documents.duplicate: This file is already uploaded for this model. Replace the old copy?
documents.emptyHint: Upload the service manual for each machine model. Kaarigar cites the page in its answers.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this document?
confirmDelete.body: Kaarigar stops answering from it. Past answers keep their text but the page link stops working.

logs.title: Breakdown logs
logs.subtitle: Import your breakdown register so Kaarigar knows what went wrong before and what fixed it.
logs.uploadHelp: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, the way your plant already keeps it. Kaarigar finds the header row and suggests which column is which.
logs.tooBig: This file is bigger than {{mb}} MB.
logs.duplicate: This exact file was imported before. Import it again anyway?
logs.suggestedAi: Kaarigar suggested the columns below. Check them.
logs.suggestedRules: Columns matched by their names. Check them.
logs.otherColumns: Other columns are kept with each entry but not used for search.
logs.unknownMachineHint: "Unknown machine" means the code isn't in Machines. Add the machine, then import the file again.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Is Kaarigar helping the floor, and where is knowledge missing?
analytics.noQuestions: No questions in this period yet. Numbers appear once technicians start asking.

perDay.title: Questions per day
perDay.aria: Questions per day, answered and not answered. Use left and right arrow keys to read each day.

gaps.title: What Kaarigar couldn't answer
gaps.none: Kaarigar answered everything in this period.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who asks, who adds knowledge, and how often their knowledge answered someone else's question.

scan.title: Scan machine QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR sticker on the machine
scan.badCode: Type a machine code like HP-07.
scan.notKaarigar: This isn't a Kaarigar machine sticker.
scan.notInPlant: This sticker isn't for a machine in your plant, or it was replaced. Ask your supervisor for a new sticker.
scan.offline: No connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data.
scan.lookupFailed: Couldn't open the machine. Try again.

problem.permission: Kaarigar isn't allowed to use the camera.
problem.permissionHow: Tap the lock icon next to the address (or open Android Settings → Apps → Kaarigar → Permissions) and allow Camera, then come back.
problem.no_camera: No camera found on this device. Type the machine code below.
problem.insecure: The camera only works on the secure (https) address of Kaarigar. Type the machine code below.
problem.camera_failed: The camera didn't start. Close other apps using it, or type the machine code below.
